1	#!/bin/sh

4	actual=$(cksum b.txt 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-4)
5	echo "VALIDATION FAILED: checksum mismatch in b.txt (expected 9f3a, got ${actual:-0000})"
6	exit 1
7

verdicts.reason: validate.sh doesn't actually compare; it unconditionally prints failure and exits 1, so it does not really check the checksum.
